cohort: The study included 95 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent either a McDonald or Shirodkar cerclage at St. Francis Hospital between January 2008 and October 2013.
finding: Obese women who received a Shirodkar cerclage had significantly longer pregnancies (32.6 ± 1.0 weeks) compared to obese women who received a McDonald cerclage (28.8 ± 0.9 weeks), with durations similar to normal/overweight women.
